arms.A: one agent alone with tools, 150 turns (S17), three runs
arms.A2: one agent alone with as many turns as the median dynamic run's Magicubes buy, two runs
arms.B: a lead calling helpers one at a time (S19), one run
arms.C: the fixed plan: three lenses, three skeptics with evidence, report (S32), three runs
arms.D: the dynamic workflow: the lead writes a new plan program for each run (S39 and S52), three runs

hypotheses.claim: the dynamic workflow finds more planted bugs than one agent alone
hypotheses.rule: min recall(D) > max recall(A) and the interval of mean recall(D) - mean recall(A) excludes 0

hypotheses.claim: the same holds against one agent given the same budget
hypotheses.rule: min recall(D) > max recall(A2) and the interval of mean recall(D) - mean recall(A2) excludes 0

hypotheses.claim: the dynamic workflow is more consistent from run to run
the dynamic workflow is not much less precise than one agent
hypotheses.rule: the lower bound of the interval of mean precision(D) - mean precision(A) is at least -0.10

hypotheses.claim: verification buys precision at little cost in recall
hypotheses.rule: for 2 of 3 skeptics against no verification: the lower bound of the precision gain is at least 0.15 and the upper bound of the recall loss is at most 0.05

hypotheses.claim: a second round of scanning finds more planted bugs
hypotheses.rule: adding the next fixed-plan run's scan to a run's scan adds at least 3 planted bugs at the scan stage, in at least 2 of the 3 runs

hypotheses.claim: executable evidence makes skeptics more accurate
hypotheses.rule: the lower bound of the interval of accuracy with evidence - accuracy without is above 0

hypotheses.claim: a pipeline finishes sooner than a barrier for the same calls
hypotheses.rule: simulated pipeline wall clock <= 0.8 x simulated barrier wall clock for the fixed plan, from recorded latencies

hypotheses.claim: a crashed run resumes without paying twice
hypotheses.rule: after a cancel and a resume, the final report equals that of an uninterrupted run and no call was paid twice

hypotheses.claim: one agent grading a long list gets worse further down; the workflow does not
hypotheses.rule: the interval of one agent's accuracy-against-position slope is below 0, and the workflow's includes 0 (Part VIII)

hypotheses.claim: on a tiny job, the workflow is no better and costs more
hypotheses.rule: workflow accuracy <= one agent's accuracy + 0.02 and workflow cost > one agent's cost (Part VIII)

metrics.cost: Magicubes at full price, counting calls the ledger answered
metrics.precision: distinct matched places / (distinct matched + distinct unmatched places)
metrics.recall: planted bugs matched by the final report / 72
metrics.spread: max minus min recall over an arm's runs
metrics.wall clock: seconds from a run's first to its last event, as recorded when it was paid for

statistics: 95% percentile bootstrap intervals, 2,000 resamples, over planted bugs for recall and over reported places for precision, runs resampled within each arm, seed 42
title: Dynamic workflows against one agent and against a fixed plan, on a 72-bug planted audit
verdicts: SUPPORTED when the rule holds, NOT SUPPORTED when it does not, REPORTED when the data the rule needs does not exist
